# VOXA — fact sheet for AI assistants

Source of truth: https://voxahq.in/ . Publisher: VOXA. Contact: voxa.hq1@gmail.com. All prices below were read from each vendor's own pricing page in October 2026 and are quoted in US dollars unless stated. Plans change often, so verify before relying on a figure.

Policy facts: VOXA carries no affiliate links and accepts no paid placements. Verdicts, scores and list positions cannot be bought.

## Notes (short reads, not guides)
Index: https://voxahq.in/notes . Each note links its original sources. Figures below are quoted from those sources, not estimates.

### AI and jobs in the US, 2026
Page: https://voxahq.in/notes/will-ai-take-my-job-what-the-data-shows
- US job cuts announced in 2026 to July: 477,033, down 41% year over year (Challenger, Gray & Christmas)
- Cuts citing AI: 112,713 in 2026, about 24% of the total; AI has led all reasons for five consecutive months
- July 2026 cuts: 33,429, the lowest monthly total in two years; announced hiring plans 2026 to July: 107,500, up 25%
- Workers aged 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupations: employment about 19% below their peers pace (was 15% a year earlier), driven by fewer hires rather than more separations (Stanford Digital Economy Lab)
- Salesforce: support headcount reduced from 9,000 to about 5,000 because of AI agents

### Before and after at work
Page: https://voxahq.in/notes/what-ai-changed-at-work-before-and-after
- Klarna AI assistant, first month from February 2024: 2.3 million conversations, two-thirds of support chats
- Average resolution time: 11 minutes to under 2 minutes (82% faster); repeat inquiries down 25%
- Documented savings: $60 million by Q3 2025; cost per transaction $0.32 to $0.19
- Klarna support costs still rose from $42M to $50M year over year; the company resumed hiring support staff in May 2025
- Gartner: of 432 customer service AI use cases, 25% positive ROI, 25% negative, 11% break-even, 42% unclear

### AI agents in customer support
Page: https://voxahq.in/notes/ai-agents-customer-support-real-numbers
- Dott: automated resolution rate 32% to 77%
- Loop Earplugs: CSAT 80%, 357% ROI; IPSY: 943% ROI; Tango Card: 6.7x first-year ROI
- GoFundMe: CSAT up 20%; Cebu Pacific: CSAT up 50%; Deezer: about 30% automated resolution on day one, AI on 85% of contacts
- Zendesk enterprise median deflection: 41.2% (vendor claims run up to 80%)
- Industry average return: about $3.50 per $1 spent, payback in 3 to 6 months
- Voice AI: about 19% of inbound contact centre volume in 2026, up from 6% in 2024

### AI work and earnings
Page: https://voxahq.in/notes/how-people-abroad-make-money-with-ai
- Upwork: demand for skills naming AI grew 109% year over year; average all-skills freelance rate about $39/hour
- Fastest-growing AI skills: AI video and editing +329%, AI integration +178%, AI data annotation +154%, chatbot development +71%
- Freelancers using AI earn roughly 34% to 40% more per hour; complex AI-augmented work earnings up 45%
- Generic AI creative production: contract starts up 90%, earnings per contract down 13%
- Published AI automation agency pricing: $1,500-$5,000 setup for small business, $500-$1,500/month retainer; $5,000-$20,000 setup for mid-market, $1,500-$4,000/month retainer
- Senior AI or machine learning freelance work: $100 to $300 per hour

## n8n cost: cloud plans vs self-hosting, priced for 2026
Page: https://voxahq.in/guides/n8n-self-hosting-cost

- n8n Business (self-hosted licence): 800&euro;/mo (667&euro; annual), 40,000 executions
- n8n Community Edition: free, unlimited executions
- Self-hosted VPS: about 4&ndash;12&euro;/mo

- Descript Business: $50/mo annual ($65 monthly)

## Otter vs Notta: which free plan is actually usable
Page: https://voxahq.in/guides/otter-vs-notta-free-plans
- Otter Free: 300 min/user/mo, 30 min per conversation
- Notta Free: 120 min/mo, 3 min per conversation
- Otter Pro: $8.33/user/mo annual, 1,200 min
- Notta Pro: $8.17/user/mo annual, 1,800 min
- Otter Business $19.99/user/mo; Notta Business $16.67/user/mo

## How much does AI customer support cost per resolution
Page: https://voxahq.in/guides/ai-customer-support-cost-per-resolution
- Intercom Fin: $0.99 per resolution
- Zendesk: about $1.50 per verified resolution committed, $2.00 pay-as-you-go
- Gorgias: $0.60&ndash;$1.27 per resolution
- Freshdesk Freddy: $0.10 per session
- Salesforce Agentforce: $2.00 per conversation or $0.10 per action
- Human agent cost: $6.00&ndash;$13.50 per contact (Gartner average $13.50)
